sql:
WITH payout_eur AS (
  SELECT p.tenant_id,
         p.gross_amount / er.rate AS gross_eur,
         p.fee_amount / er.rate AS fee_eur,
         p.net_amount / er.rate AS net_eur
  FROM payouts p
  JOIN exchange_rates er
    ON er.base_code = 'EUR'
   AND er.quote_code = p.currency_code
   AND er.as_of = CAST(p.paid_at AS date)
  WHERE p.paid_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND p.paid_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND p.status NOT IN ('failed','reversed','cancelled','void')
),
agg AS (
  SELECT tenant_id,
         SUM(gross_eur) AS gross_volume_eur,
         SUM(fee_eur) AS fee_revenue_eur,
         SUM(net_eur) AS net_paid_eur
  FROM payout_eur
  GROUP BY tenant_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT a.tenant_id,
         a.gross_volume_eur,
         a.fee_revenue_eur,
         a.net_paid_eur,
         SUM(a.fee_revenue_eur) OVER () AS total_fee_eur
  FROM agg a
)
SELECT
  t.name AS merchant_name,
  t.industry AS vertical,
  ROUND(r.gross_volume_eur, 2) AS gross_payment_volume_eur,
  ROUND(r.fee_revenue_eur, 2) AS fee_revenue_eur,
  ROUND(r.net_paid_eur, 2) AS net_paid_eur,
  ROUND(100.0 * r.fee_revenue_eur / NULLIF(r.total_fee_eur,0), 2) AS fee_share_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.fee_revenue_eur) OVER (ORDER BY r.fee_revenue_eur DESC, t.name ASC ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) / NULLIF(r.total_fee_eur,0), 2) AS cumulative_fee_share_pct
FROM ranked r
JOIN tenants t ON t.id = r.tenant_id
ORDER BY r.fee_revenue_eur DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 50
note: payouts.status has no documented enum in the catalog, so "completed/settled" was interpreted as paid_at not null AND status not in ('failed','reversed','cancelled','void') — please flag if the actual status codes differ. The total number of tenants with any payout in the window will show as the report's total-row count (handled by the print process), since the grain is one row per such tenant.
